"""Sloped-curb parked-headlamp Native acquisition; no legal classification."""
import argparse
import json
import math
import queue
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from parked_lamps import check_config,read_and_measure

def capture(cfg,output_dir,host='127.0.0.1',port=2000):
    import carla
    from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture
    from worker_exchange.native_output import FrameMap,seal_capture
    from worker_exchange.world_restore import snapshot,restore
    root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    check_config(cfg,(root/'sloped-curb-road.xodr').read_text())
    output=Path(output_dir).resolve()
    if not output.is_dir() or (output/'native-rows.jsonl').exists():
        raise ValueError('New empty attempt directory required')
    client=carla.Client(host,port);client.set_timeout(180)
    prior=snapshot(client);old=client.get_world()
    if prior['settings'].synchronous_mode or any(a.type_id.startswith(
            ('vehicle.','walker.','sensor.','controller.')) for a in old.get_actors()):
        raise RuntimeError('Exclusive idle Native world required')
    owned=[];encoders={};cameras={};pipeline=None;changed=False;complete=False
    try:
        world=client.generate_opendrive_world((root/'sloped-curb-road.xodr').read_text(),
            carla.OpendriveGenerationParameters(vertex_distance=.5,max_road_length=10,
                wall_height=0,additional_width=0,smooth_junctions=False,
                enable_mesh_visibility=True,enable_pedestrian_navigation=True))
        changed=True
        (output/'road.xodr').write_text(world.get_map().to_opendrive())
        settings=world.get_settings();settings.synchronous_mode=True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds=.05;settings.substepping=True
        settings.max_substep_delta_time=.01;settings.max_substeps=10
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        waypoint=world.get_map().get_waypoint(carla.Location(x=5.50,y=0,z=2.4),
            project_to_road=True,lane_type=carla.LaneType.Parking)
        if waypoint is None or waypoint.lane_id!=-2:
            raise RuntimeError('Requested curb parking lane unavailable')
        library=world.get_blueprint_library()
        vehicles=sorted(library.filter('vehicle.*'),key=lambda b:b.id)
        if not vehicles:raise RuntimeError('Vehicle blueprint unavailable')
        bp=vehicles[0];bp.set_attribute('role_name','c276263_parked_lamp_subject')
        ego=world.spawn_actor(bp,carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=5.50,y=0,z=2.8),
            carla.Rotation(yaw=90)));owned.append(ego)
        low=int(carla.VehicleLightState.LowBeam);high=int(carla.VehicleLightState.HighBeam)
        selected=low if cfg['requested_beam_state']=='low_beam' else high
        ego.set_light_state(carla.VehicleLightState(selected))
        pipeline=PipelineCapture(client,ego,output,cfg['case_id'],visibility=False,
            required_observations=cfg.get('required_atoms',[]))
        (output/'review-pending.json').write_text(json.dumps({
            'beam_pixel_review':'pending','parking_activity_review':'pending',
            'vehicle_class_review':'pending','physical_completion':False,
            'legal_verdict':None},indent=2)+'\n')
        for spec in cfg['cameras']:
            name=spec['name'];camera_bp=library.find('sensor.camera.rgb')
            for key,value in [('image_size_x',spec['width']),
                    ('image_size_y',spec['height']),('sensor_tick','.05'),
                    ('fov',spec['fov_deg'])]:camera_bp.set_attribute(key,str(value))
            xyz=spec['location_xyz_m'];pyr=spec['rotation_pyr_deg']
            camera=world.spawn_actor(camera_bp,carla.Transform(
                carla.Location(x=xyz[0],y=xyz[1],z=xyz[2]),
                carla.Rotation(pitch=pyr[0],roll=pyr[1],yaw=pyr[2])),
                attach_to=ego if name=='driver_reference' else None)
            owned.append(camera);q=queue.Queue();camera.listen(q.put);cameras[name]=q
            encoders[name]=subprocess.Popen(['ffmpeg','-nostdin','-hide_banner',
                '-loglevel','error','-y','-f','rawvideo','-pix_fmt','bgra','-s',
                f"{spec['width']}x{spec['height']}",'-r','20','-i','-',
                '-frames:v','600','-c:v','ffv1','-level','1',str(output/(name+'.mkv'))],
                stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        with FrameMap(output/'video_frames.jsonl') as frame_map, \
                (output/'native-rows.jsonl').open('x') as rows:
            for i in range(600):
                ego.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=0,brake=1,hand_brake=True))
                frame=world.tick();snap=world.get_snapshot()
                if snap.frame!=frame:raise RuntimeError('Native frame/snapshot mismatch')
                t=(i+1)/20;pipeline.capture(frame,t);camera_frames={}
                for name,q in cameras.items():
                    image=q.get(timeout=30)
                    while image.frame<frame:image=q.get(timeout=30)
                    if image.frame!=frame:raise RuntimeError('Camera/frame mismatch: '+name)
                    encoders[name].stdin.write(image.raw_data);camera_frames[name]=image.frame
                frame_map.append(frame,t,camera_native_frames=camera_frames)
                pose=ego.get_transform();velocity=ego.get_velocity();center=pose.location
                corners=ego.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(pose)
                bits=int(ego.get_light_state())
                observed='high_beam' if bits & high else 'low_beam' if bits & low else 'off'
                lane=world.get_map().get_waypoint(center,project_to_road=True,
                    lane_type=carla.LaneType.Parking)
                row={'frame':i,'native_frame':frame,'time_s':t,
                    'source_kind':'original_native','ego_actor_id':ego.id,
                    'ego_blueprint_id':ego.type_id,
                    'ego_center_xyz_m':[center.x,center.y,center.z],
                    'ego_speed_mps':math.sqrt(velocity.x**2+velocity.y**2+velocity.z**2),
                    'observed_footprint_xyz_m':[[p.x,p.y,p.z] for p in corners],
                    'observed_curb_lane_id':lane.lane_id if lane else None,
                    'requested_headlamp_lit':True,
                    'requested_beam_state':cfg['requested_beam_state'],
                    'observed_light_state_bits':bits,'observed_beam_state':observed,
                    'observed_parking_activity':'unknown',
                    'beam_pixel_review':{'status':'pending'},
                    'source_cameras':camera_frames}
                rows.write(json.dumps(row)+'\n')
        for name,proc in encoders.items():
            proc.stdin.close();error=proc.stderr.read()
            if proc.wait(timeout=180) or not (output/(name+'.mkv')).is_file():
                raise RuntimeError('Camera encode failed: '+name+': '+error.decode()[-300:])
        complete=True
        return {'frames':600,'cameras':list(cameras),
            'beam_pixel_review':'pending','parking_activity_review':'pending',
            'physical_completion_claimed':False}
    finally:
        if pipeline is not None:pipeline.close(confirmed=complete)
        for proc in encoders.values():
            if proc.poll() is None:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        for actor in reversed(owned):
            try:
                if hasattr(actor,'stop'):actor.stop()
                actor.destroy()
            except Exception:pass
        restored=restore(client,prior) if changed else {'restored':True}
        if complete:
            seal_capture(output,frames=600,restoration=restored,errors=[],
                encoder_exit_codes={name:p.returncode for name,p in encoders.items()},
                context={'case_id':cfg['case_id'],
                    'candidate_id':cfg.get('candidate_id','primary'),
                    'original_beam_and_parking_review':'pending'})

def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--check',action='store_true')
    p.add_argument('--measure-request');p.add_argument('--capture')
    p.add_argument('--output-dir')
    p.add_argument('--host',default='127.0.0.1')
    p.add_argument('--port',type=int,default=2000);a=p.parse_args()
    root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    cfg=json.loads((root/'config.json').read_text())
    out=check_config(cfg,(root/'sloped-curb-road.xodr').read_text())
    if a.measure_request:
        out['request_meter']=read_and_measure(a.measure_request,'authored_native_request')
    if a.capture or a.output_dir:
        out=capture(cfg,a.capture or a.output_dir,a.host,a.port)
    elif not a.check and not a.measure_request:
        raise ValueError('Specify --check or --capture')
    print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))

if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Join sealed lamp sources; preserve parking and beam review provenance."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from parked_lamps import FRAMES,VIEWS,measure

REVIEW_FILES=('parking-activity-review.json','beam-aim-intensity-review.json')
SOURCE_FILES=('native-rows.jsonl','video_frames.jsonl','observed-lamp-review.jsonl',
              'road.xodr')+tuple(
    view+'.mkv' for view in VIEWS)

def rows(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines()]

def source(attempt,name,digest):
    if Path(name).name!=name or name.startswith('.'):
        raise ValueError('Source path must be a direct attempt child')
    path=attempt/name
    if not path.is_file() or hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=digest:
        raise ValueError('Original source missing or hash differs: '+name)
    return path

def finalize(attempt_dir,review_manifest_path):
    attempt=Path(attempt_dir).resolve();manifest_path=Path(review_manifest_path).resolve()
    if manifest_path.parent!=attempt:
        raise ValueError('Review manifest must reside in the attempt')
    manifest=json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
    if manifest.get('source_kind')!='original_native' or manifest.get('legal_verdict') is not None:
        raise ValueError('Original source and no legal verdict required')
    if manifest.get('case_id') not in (
            'training__C276263__NRS-484D-165-4__motor_vehicle_driver__probe_a',
            'training__C276263__NRS-484D-165-4__motor_vehicle_driver__probe_b'):
        raise ValueError('Exact parked-lamp case identity required')
    declared=manifest.get('sha256')
    if not isinstance(declared,dict) or set(declared)!=set(REVIEW_FILES+SOURCE_FILES):
        raise ValueError('Exact Native camera and review source set required')
    sources={name:source(attempt,name,declared[name])
             for name in REVIEW_FILES+SOURCE_FILES}
    for name in REVIEW_FILES:
        review=json.loads(sources[name].read_text())
        if (review.get('source_kind')!='original_native' or
                review.get('review_status')!='verified' or
                not review.get('source_basis') or review.get('legal_verdict') is not None):
            raise ValueError('Original parking or beam review is pending: '+name)
    native=rows(sources['native-rows.jsonl'])
    frames=rows(sources['video_frames.jsonl'])
    observed=rows(sources['observed-lamp-review.jsonl'])
    if not all(len(items)==FRAMES for items in (native,frames,observed)):
        raise ValueError('Full 600-frame original source set required')
    assembled=[]
    for i,(n,f,o) in enumerate(zip(native,frames,observed)):
        if (n.get('frame')!=i or f.get('video_frame')!=i or o.get('frame')!=i or
                n.get('native_frame')!=f.get('native_frame') or
                o.get('native_frame')!=f.get('native_frame') or
                n.get('time_s')!=f.get('time_s') or o.get('time_s')!=f.get('time_s')):
            raise ValueError('Original Native/frame/review identities differ')
        camera_frames=f.get('camera_native_frames')
        if not isinstance(camera_frames,dict) or set(camera_frames)!=set(VIEWS):
            raise ValueError('Four original camera frame identities required')
        if n.get('source_cameras')!=camera_frames or any(
                value!=n['native_frame'] for value in camera_frames.values()):
            raise ValueError('Original camera frame join differs')
        review=o.get('beam_pixel_review')
        if not isinstance(review,dict) or review.get('source_path') not in tuple(
                view+'.mkv' for view in VIEWS):
            raise ValueError('Source-bound beam pixel review missing')
        if review.get('source_sha256')!=declared[review['source_path']]:
            raise ValueError('Beam pixel source hash differs')
        row=dict(n)
        row['observed_parking_activity']=o.get('observed_parking_activity')
        row['beam_pixel_review']=review
        assembled.append(row)
    result=measure(assembled,'original_native')
    result['case_id']=manifest['case_id']
    if (result['parked_activity_frames']!=FRAMES or
            result['beam_pixel_reviewed_frames']!=FRAMES or
            result['observed_beam_states']!=[assembled[0]['requested_beam_state']] or
            any(row['ego_speed_mps']>.1 or row['observed_curb_lane_id']!=-2
                for row in assembled)):
        raise ValueError('Original parked and lighted source window incomplete')
    result['beam_aim_elevation_deg_range']=[
        min(row['beam_pixel_review']['aim_elevation_deg'] for row in assembled),
        max(row['beam_pixel_review']['aim_elevation_deg'] for row in assembled)]
    result['relative_intensity_range']=[
        min(row['beam_pixel_review']['relative_intensity'] for row in assembled),
        max(row['beam_pixel_review']['relative_intensity'] for row in assembled)]
    result['source_sha256']=declared
    result['fixed_context']={
        'road_sha256':declared['road.xodr'],
        'ego_blueprint_id':native[0].get('ego_blueprint_id'),
        'curb_lane_id':-2,
        'duration_s':30,
        'rate_hz':20,
        'source_cameras':list(VIEWS)}
    result['review_manifest_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(manifest_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if manifest.get('synthetic_cpu_fixture') is True:
        result['original_native_observed']=False
        result['source_kind']='synthetic_cpu_fixture'
    return result

"""Selected saved lamp analysis. A synthetic fixture tests software shape only."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

VIEWS=('overview','approach','reference_corner','driver_reference')
SOURCES=('native-rows.jsonl','lamp-review.jsonl','parking-context.json',
         'video_frames.jsonl','trace.jsonl','capture/evidence.jsonl')

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def rows(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines()]

def measure_parked_lamps(attempt):
    attempt=Path(attempt)
    native=rows(attempt/'native-rows.jsonl')
    review=rows(attempt/'lamp-review.jsonl')
    frames=rows(attempt/'video_frames.jsonl')
    trace=rows(attempt/'trace.jsonl')
    evidence=rows(attempt/'capture/evidence.jsonl')
    context=json.loads((attempt/'parking-context.json').read_text())
    if len(native)!=len(review)!=len(frames)!=len(trace)!=len(evidence) or len(native)!=600:
        raise ValueError('Complete 600-frame parked lamp observation required')
    for i,(n,r,f,t,e) in enumerate(zip(native,review,frames,trace,evidence)):
        if (n.get('frame')!=i or r.get('frame')!=i or f.get('video_frame')!=i
                or n.get('native_frame')!=f.get('native_frame')
                or t.get('frame')!=f.get('carla_frame')
                or any(abs(row.get('time_s',-999)-f['time_s'])>1e-6 for row in (n,r,t))
                or e.get('original_frame')!=f.get('native_frame')):
            raise ValueError('Original Native/frame/review identity differs')
        if n.get('observed_curb_lane_id')!=-2 or n.get('ego_speed_mps',999)>.1:
            raise ValueError('Original parked footprint window incomplete')
        if n.get('observed_beam_state') not in ('low_beam','high_beam'):
            raise ValueError('Original lighted headlamp readback missing')
        if r.get('parking_activity')!='parked' or r.get('aim_elevation_deg') is None or r.get('relative_intensity') is None:
            raise ValueError('Source-bound beam and parking review missing')
        if not isinstance(n.get('observed_footprint_xyz_m'),list) or len(n['observed_footprint_xyz_m'])<4:
            raise ValueError('Original full body footprint missing')
    state={r['observed_beam_state'] for r in native}
    if len(state)!=1 or context.get('cell_id')!='C276263' or context.get('road_grade_percent')!=4:
        raise ValueError('Exact slope or stable beam source absent')
    return {'frames':600,'observed_beam_state':state.pop(),
            'aim_elevation_deg_range':[min(r['aim_elevation_deg'] for r in review),max(r['aim_elevation_deg'] for r in review)],
            'relative_intensity_range':[min(r['relative_intensity'] for r in review),max(r['relative_intensity'] for r in review)],
            'parked_activity_frames':600,'road_grade_percent':4,
            'source_kind':context.get('source_kind')}

def finalize(attempt,output):
    attempt,output=Path(attempt),Path(output)
    if output.exists() or (attempt/'result.json').exists():
        raise ValueError('Retain previous saved output; use a fresh attempt')
    for name in (*SOURCES,*(view+'.mkv' for view in VIEWS),'config.json','construction.json'):
        if not (attempt/name).is_file():
            raise ValueError('Missing required source: '+name)
    config=json.loads((attempt/'config.json').read_text())
    construction=json.loads((attempt/'construction.json').read_text())
    case=config['selected_case_id']
    if construction['case_id']!=case:
        raise ValueError('Selected case identity differs')
    context=json.loads((attempt/'parking-context.json').read_text())
    if context.get('case_id')!=case or context.get('source_kind') not in ('synthetic_cpu_fixture','original_native'):
        raise ValueError('Source context identity/provenance differs')
    measured=measure_parked_lamps(attempt)
    if measured['observed_beam_state']!=config['requested_beam_state']:
        raise ValueError('Observed beam differs from selected target')
    if context['source_kind']=='original_native':
        from finalize_original import finalize as finalize_original
        original=finalize_original(attempt,attempt/'source-review-manifest.json')
        if original.get('original_native_observed') is not True:
            raise ValueError('Original review manifest cannot be synthetic')
    channel_dir=attempt/'channels'
    channel_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    native=rows(attempt/'native-rows.jsonl')
    values={'drv.standing_or_parked':lambda row: 'parked',
            'sig.headlamp':lambda row: row['observed_beam_state'],
            'kin.velocity':lambda row: [0.0,0.0,0.0],
            'rel.occupies':lambda row: row['observed_curb_lane_id']}
    recording=[]
    for channel in construction['recording_description']['channels']:
        name=channel['name']
        if name not in values:raise ValueError('Unknown selected channel: '+name)
        path=channel_dir/(name+'.jsonl')
        with path.open('x') as stream:
            for row in native:
                stream.write(json.dumps({'time_s':row['time_s'],'value':values[name](row)})+'\n')
        recording.append({'name':name,'unit':channel['unit'],'reference':'channels/'+path.name})
    source_hashes={name:sha(attempt/name) for name in SOURCES}
    report={'format':'worker-analysis-report','case_id':case,
            'measurements':{'parked_headlamp_observation':{
                'method':'measure_parked_lamps','value':measured,'sources':source_hashes}},
            'source_complete':True,'diagnostic_fixture':context['source_kind']=='synthetic_cpu_fixture',
            'physical_or_legal_acceptance':False}
    result={'case_id':case,'measured_values':measured,
            'target_checks':[{'target':'observed selected beam state','requested':config['requested_beam_state'],
                'measured':measured['observed_beam_state'],'method':'measure_parked_lamps','tolerance':0,
                'matched':True,'physical_cause_confirmed':False,'cause_evidence':list(SOURCES)}],
            'setup_confirmed':False,'behavior_attempted':False,'maneuver_completed':False,
            'termination_reason':'Saved source analyzed; physical and legal review remains separate',
            'physical_failure_flags':['Actual parked activity and beam aim/intensity not physically accepted'],
            'trace_reference':'trace.jsonl','video_references':[v+'.mkv' for v in VIEWS],
            'video_frame_map_reference':'video_frames.jsonl',
            'recording_description':construction['recording_description'],
            'recording_evidence':recording,'realized_observables':{},
            'provenance_kind':context['source_kind'],'accepted':False}
    from worker_exchange.native_output import write_result
    write_result(attempt,result)
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
    return report

if __name__=='__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--attempt',required=True);p.add_argument('--output',required=True)
    a=p.parse_args();finalize(a.attempt,a.output)
